author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260512T045359Z-1929490
text:
Labeling human for /do-beads filter. Bead body says "Design likely couples to JMAP-cf7p.10 (SSE Last-Event-ID) and JMAP-cf7p.9 (signal-driven push); these three could land as a coordinated cluster."

Specific decision needed from Mark — coupling/sequencing:

1. Land as cluster after .9 + .10 designs are picked.
2. Thin standalone WS-only slice that mirrors whatever scheme .10 lands with.
3. Drop pushState honor entirely as out-of-scope-for-testjig (the testjig is NOT FOR PRODUCTION; clients reconnecting can use Foo/changes).

Recommendation: option (2) — pair with .10 in one PR, sharing the same event-id scheme. RFC 8887 §4.3.5.2 is a SHOULD not MUST, and option (3) would leave a noticeable behavioral gap from the SSE path if .10 lands but .12 doesn't.

Filed per AGENTS.md "Turn questions into beads" rule.
